translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Minana nakalimwala siligaga

E taitala matausina anelosi tailima taiyu, matausina leiyosisi kailuya kailima kaiyu, imakaiagu ikaibiga, kawala, “Kuma! Bavitulokaim ammakawala minana nakalimwala siligaga bikeula kala pakula. Baisa mapilana vilouveka
tumilela katitaikina sakala bidubadu.
Guyousi mina watanawa ikikailasisi deli minana nakalimwala siligaga, e mina watanawa eimomsi wainila la kalimwala iwaiya kaibotutu.”

E Baloma Tobumaboma iviyelu nanogu e anelosi ikauwaigu kalokaia oviloupakala. E baisa agisi natana vivila eisila otapwala buludililama nabweyani, e minana buludililama tapwala ikasewa bidubadu yegila igimigigaga eiginisi; e kununela kwailima kwaiyu e kala doga kasilatala.

Minana vivila eisikam kala kwama kala gigisa makawala dairarugu deli marakana, e kala katububula veiguwa goula, dakuna kwevivivila e waitunatoula. Oyamala iyosi viga goula ivakasau bubunela gaga deli vavagi mwau metoya ola kakailasi minana nakalimwala.
Odabala iginisi yegila igikikium. Maigana kala katumiki baisa makawala. “Mapilana Babiloni vilouveka, inasi komwaidosi nakalimwala deli komwaidosi bubunesi doudoga ovalu watanawa.”

E agisi wala minana eimomom iwaiya kaibotutu uula eimom buyavisi la tomota Yaubada deli buyavisi matausina Yesu la towotetila availa availa leikatumataisi. E tutala agisi minana saina iyowa lopogu sainela.

E anelosi ikatupoiyaigu, kawala, “Ki, avaka paila iyowa lopom? Balukwaim avaka kala katumiki minana vivila deli minana buludililama avaka minana vivila eisila, e minawena kununela kwailima kwaiyu deli kasilatala kala doga.

Minana buludililama lokugisi, ka, omitibogwa namomova taga tuta baisa nakaliga. E makateki minana bilaguva bima metoya oUveya e bilauwaisi ilavaisi minana. E matausina mina watanawa availa availa yagasi gala iginibogwaisi mapilana bukila momova tutala gala isim valu, komwaidosi wala biyowa luposi tutala bigigisaisi minana buludililama. Paila omitibogwa nammomova taga tuta baisa nakaliga. Mitaga igau biyoumatilavau.

“Vavagi baisa ibodi wala tokabitam kaina tokwateta binevi uulotoula. Baisa kala katumiki. Kununa kwailima kwaiyu baisa kwailima kwaiyu koya e minana isisu odubasi koya makwaisina. Tuvaila kununa bitadoki tailima taiyu gweguya.
Tailima matausina gweguya bogwa ilisaisi si guyau, taitalaga tovau iguguyau tuta baisa e kesala taitala igau wala gala bima. E igau matauna tovabodanim bima, ibodi tuta pikekita wala bisisu.

E minana buludililama omitibogwa nammomova taga tuta baisa nakaliga minawena baisa tailima taitolula guyouvau kala katumkovila si boda matausina tailima taiyu igiyoubogwasi, taga bilauwaisi ilavaisi matauna.
“E doga makaisina kasilatala baisa tailuwotala gweguya taga gala biguguyausi igau wala. Mitaga igau bikasalaisi karaiwaga baisa matausina biguyausi gala imomwa deli minana buludililama.
E kasitailuwotala komwaidosi ninasi ninatala wala e ikasalaisi si karaiwaga si guyau baisa buludililama.

Igau bikabiliasi deli matauna Lam. Mitaga Lam deli matausina kala tobwakuli tokimadagi availa availa idou deli inagi, e mabudona goli bitomgwagasi, paila matauna Lam baisa gweguya si Guyau deli kini si Kini.”
E tuvaila anelosi ilukwaigu, kawala, “Ka, lokugisi makwaisina sakala minana nakalimwala la kaisisu, baisa bidubadu tomota deli tobobawa deli valu deli bona.

E lokugisi minana buludililama deli kala doga kasilatala, ka, matausina bikoulovaisi minana nakalimwala. Bikauwaisi komwaidona avaka avaka eisisii minana e nakimwadu wala bisim. Bikomasi vilionela minana e bivakadidaimisi wa kova.

Paila Yaubada isaibogwi oninasi mwada magisi bivagaisi nanola, kidamwa gulitinidesi bivagaisi avaka avaka. E mapaila bikasalaisi si guyau baisa minana buludililama igau tutala bivigimkulovaisi Yaubada la biga.
“E lokugisi minana nakalimwala baisa mapilana valu vilouveka tuta baisa ikikaraiwogi gweguya ovalu watanawa.”

footnotes.text: Mapilana Roum; mitaga buki mapilana idoki Babiloni (kugisi YG 14.8).
